title: Can We Jump from Cross-Sectional to Dynamic Interpretations of Networks? Implications for the Network Perspective in Psychiatry
limitations: - Limited to 5 days of data; - No formal statistical test for centrality comparisons; - Cross-sectional networks may not reflect causal dynamics; - Sample size may be insufficient for robust network estimation.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. The authors mention using STATA and R, but no repository or link is provided. Preregistration status is not mentioned.
